grayscale: Decode sRGB -> linear Rec709 luminance (.2126,.7152,.0722) -> encode sRGB; no contrast enhancement.
assessment: Manual visual inspection required; Drum silhouette and two rolled bands are the primary non-color cues; small/far views require recorded manual assessment, not a text-readability guarantee. Far perspective views are smaller; no claim of text readability or final art approval.
sampling: Contact sheets downsample whole frames with nearest-neighbor only for presentation. Native crop files and small-gameplay-readability.png do not resize assets or pixels.
